title: GTSD loopback console launch configuration

source_root.description: Project root; relative paths are resolved from this configuration file, not the shell working directory.

port.description: 127.0.0.1 only; 0 lets the operating system choose an ephemeral port.

resume.description: Explicit complete console checkpoint path; null always means a fresh paused model. No automatic cache lookup.

$comment: Runtime validation also rejects duplicate keys, non-finite JSON including overflow, boolean ports, unavailable paths, wrong dependency versions, and invalid checkpoint envelopes. No JSON Schema package or schema network fetch is required.
